name: skill-collision-guard
title_zh: 装新技能前先查它跟已装的是否打架
tagline_zh: 装插件前总怕两个技能抢同一句话、互相覆盖？它逐条比对触发条件，发现重叠就让你当场决定屏蔽谁，不用卸载、可逆。
tagline_en: Worried two skills will fight over the same prompt? It compares triggers, flags overlaps, and lets you suppress.
desc_en: Check for overlapping, duplicate, shadowing, or contradictory coding-agent skills before installing a skill/plugin or when multiple skills may trigger; compare them and help remove or reversibly suppress one for the current session.
why_zh: 不是装完才报错，而是在安装前就做静态冲突检测——比对触发词、指令、输出目标，把矛盾摊开给你看。
why_en: Catches clashes before install, not after—statically compares triggers, instructions, and outputs, then lets you suppress one.
limit_zh: 只检测已收录技能库内的冲突，不覆盖任意插件生态；比对基于描述文本与触发词，不执行真实调用，深层运行时冲突可能漏报。
limit_en: Only checks skills in its known library, not arbitrary plugins; compares descriptions and triggers, not runtime behavior—deep execution conflicts.
title_en: Check new skills for clashes before installing
